latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Français Photo Video Maker.

- Create French-language videos from uploaded photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB)
- Supports fast 1080p MP4 video export in 30–60 seconds
- Automatic handling of user tokens with up to 100 free credits for new users
- Easy drag-and-drop photo upload and simple, natural-language prompts
- Built-in workflows for adding music, text overlays, and more
- Clear user feedback on connection, export status, and errors
- Designed for French-speaking content creators working with images
